page.overview:
Who is Steve D'Agostino?

Joel D'Agostino (Son)|first_appearance=Kids at Play}} Steve D'Agostino is a major character in Kids at Play, the second story in Fazbear Frights 11: Prankster.

Steve has a dark face with brown eyes and strong features. He is big, broad-shouldered, and fit with precisely trimmed graying black hair and farmer's-tanned skin on the back of his neck. When he isn't working at the nursery, Steve wears flashy clothes like dressy slacks, bright shirts, and patterned ties.
